name: 00_pre_start

name: 01_start_connect

name: 02_outbound_types

name: 03_sendstate_framing
what: SendState framing: payload is written verbatim + \n (no re-serialization, no validation)

name: 04_request_id_injection

text: no string request_id on the wire; cannot correlate

name: 05_correlation
what: single pending slot: stale/missing/typed ids, supersede, cancel, timeout

name: 06_wait_for_action
what: WaitForActionAsync (uncorrelated): any line is delivered, specials are not

name: 07_no_handler
what: client lines with nothing pending are discarded silently

name: 08_ping_variants
what: ping / PING spellings and near-misses

bytes: invalid utf-8 bytes FF FE inside string

name: 12_oversized
what: very long lines in both directions

name: 13_concurrent_send
what: 8 threads x 25 SendState: lines never interleave

name: 15_second_client
